scope: Project-reported integration checks on one server, using the actual MAGIC runtime and Microduck MuJoCo simulation; not a benchmark success rate or hardware validation.

demo.planning: Fixed plan; no model call. Natural-language planning was validated in separate runs.

actions.label: Stand
actions.evidence: Rise returned the robot to the walking policy.

actions.label: Look left
actions.evidence: Head command dispatched; final joint pose was not verified.

actions.label: Snapshot
actions.evidence: Head-camera image saved; not an object-recognition result.

natural_language.goal: 向左转20度，然后坐下，再站起来
natural_language.translation: Turn left 20 degrees, sit down, then stand up.
natural_language.cancellation: Stopping a two-meter walk cancelled walking and prevented the following sit action. Cancelling during planning dispatched no actions.

replay.planning: Fixed five-action plan; actual MAGIC execution and MuJoCo simulation, no LLM call.
replay.presentation: Local filesystem paths replaced in event text before browser capture; camera images and execution data unmodified.
replay.timing: Frame timestamps retained at 5 FPS; replay runs at original speed.

navigation.scope: One arrival and kitchen-route cancellation verified; not all room routes.

boundaries: Simulation only; no physical Microduck connected.
Learned skills use Trigger services and cannot be interrupted mid-motion.
Object recognition, grasping, kicking, and rolling task outcomes are unverified.
Wall transparency affects only the third-person renderer; collisions and the head camera are unchanged.
The public website shows a recorded GIF of the fixed /demo sequence, not a live server feed.

provenance.note: Public summary transcribed from local validation records. Private runtime logs, model credentials, and databases are not distributed with the website.
